headline: Senior Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Backend Infrastructure
base_summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, scaling, and maintaining low-latency distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven data pipelines. Expert in Java, Python, Go, and cloud-native architecture.

bullets: Architected and deployed a multi-tenant event streaming pipeline using Apache Kafka processing 450M+ events/day with 99.99% availability.
Refactored monolithic ingestion service into Go-based microservices, slashing p99 API response latencies from 320ms to 42ms.
Engineered distributed caching layer with Redis Cluster, reducing RDS database read loads by 68% during peak traffic spikes.
Led team of 5 engineers in migrating core Kubernetes services across AWS regions using Terraform and zero-downtime blue/green deployments.
Designed comprehensive observability stack using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana, reducing Mean Time to Detection (MTTD) by 40%.
Developed high-throughput REST and gRPC microservices in Java and Spring Boot for financial fraud detection pipelines.
Optimized complex PostgreSQL query execution plans and partitioned database tables, decreasing batch processing times by 55%.
Automated CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and Docker, reducing team deployment cycle duration from 2 hours to 15 minutes.
Implemented real-time transaction validation system with 99.95% accuracy using Apache Flink and Kafka Streams.
Built internal developer portal and API monitoring dashboards using Python (Flask) and React.
Created end-to-end integration and load testing suites with Locust and PyTest, discovering critical concurrency bottlenecks before production.
Collaborated with cross-functional product and security teams to resolve OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities across legacy web applications.

education.highlights: Dean's Honor List, Distributed Systems Lab

projects.name: Distributed Key-Value Store (Raft)
projects.description: Implemented a fault-tolerant, replicated key-value storage engine in Go using the Raft consensus algorithm with log compaction and snapshotting.

projects.name: High-Throughput Log Aggregator
projects.description: Built an asynchronous log aggregation agent in Rust and Kafka delivering sub-second log indexing into Elasticsearch.
